entities.name: EMM common procedures
entities.description: Set of procedures that can be initiated by the MME upon receiving certain service request messages. Includes authentication procedure and security mode control procedure.

entities.name: SERVICE REQUEST
entities.description: Message received by MME that may trigger EMM common procedures.

entities.name: EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST
entities.description: Message received by MME that may trigger EMM common procedures.

entities.name: CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST
entities.description: Message received by MME that may trigger EMM common procedures.

entities.name: Authentication procedure
entities.description: EMM common procedure for authenticating the UE.

entities.name: Security mode control procedure
entities.description: EMM common procedure for establishing security context.

relations.description: Receipt of SERVICE REQUEST message may trigger initiation of EMM common procedures.
Receipt of EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST message may trigger initiation of EMM common procedures.
Receipt of CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message may trigger initiation of EMM common procedures.
EMM common procedures include authentication procedure as an example.
EMM common procedures include security mode control procedure as an example.
